selection_rule: For each target alone profile the original, 24 single modules, 12 same-block A+M resets, four fixed three-block A+M regions, and whole-network A/M/A+M resets: 44 variants. Among the 16 local joint regions meeting 5 pp standalone cost, pick the smallest block count, then largest cost, then lexicographic layers. If none meet the gate, confirm the largest-cost local region for a recorded negative result. No future partner affects this rule.
confirmation: After all three selections and their hash are frozen, run standalone and eight-expert TA on disjoint training subsets, using fixed coefficient 0.2 and four resets: A, M, A+M, and complete blocks. Original test splits are not used. DTD has only 1880 training images in the pinned author layout; 512 select and 1024 confirm, leaving 344 unused.
purpose: Necessary local-support screening, not a defense candidate, global minimum search or upper bound on adaptive recovery. Full-support reset provides an achievable recovery floor for the corresponding edit family.
